name: Woodbury Common Shopping Center
summary: Woodbury Common Shopping Center is a prominent outlet shopping destination in Woodbury, NY, offering designer and brand-name merchandise at discounted prices. Conveniently located near major highways and within easy reach of New York City, it attracts both local shoppers and tourists seeking quality brands at outlet values.
demographics: Woodbury Common Premium Outlets attracts a diverse, international visitor base with a strong presence of tourists and day-trippers from New York City, approximately 50 miles south. The primary demographic includes middle to upper-middle income households with annual incomes of $75,000+, spanning ages 25-65, who are value-conscious yet brand-oriented shoppers. The center draws significant international tourism, particularly from Asia, Europe, and Latin America, who come specifically for luxury brand outlet shopping. Families and groups frequently visit on weekends, while weekday traffic includes retirees and tourists, with visitors typically spending 3-5 hours shopping across the expansive property.
description: Woodbury Common Shopping Center, located at 8285 Jericho Turnpike in Woodbury, New York, represents one of the premier outlet shopping destinations in the northeastern United States. This expansive retail complex has established itself as a must-visit location for both local residents and international tourists seeking designer and brand-name merchandise at outlet prices. The center's strategic location, just off major highways and within an hour's drive from New York City, makes it exceptionally accessible for day trips and shopping excursions. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM, the center provides ample time for visitors to explore its diverse collection of outlet stores featuring everything from fashion and accessories to home goods and sporting equipment. The shopping center has earned a strong reputation among shoppers, reflected in its 4.4-star rating from 400 reviews, indicating consistent customer satisfaction with the shopping experience, store selection, and overall value proposition.
